summary.en: After visiting an exhibit on hidden treasures, Conan and his friends find a piece of paper with symbols and the word "Oro" written on it. A treasure hunt ensues but they do not discover much. Conan, initially not interested in the children's treasure hunt finally realizes that the paper is a treasure map after learning that "Oro" means gold in Italian. That night, Conan determines that the symbols refer to neon light signs on buildings.
